decision: Selected the official federal building-address record EGAID 102543513 (Route du Nant-d'Avril 152, 1217 Meyrin; EGID 295522333), served in WGS84 by api3.geo.admin.ch, as the project locator. NorthC publishes 'Rte du Nant-d'Avril 152, 1217 Meyrin' as the address of its planned Genf data centre in The Hive technology park.

selected_properties.address: Route du Nant-d'Avril 152, 1217 Meyrin (BFS 6630, canton GE)

identity_bridge: NorthC page 'Rechenzentrum Genf' (datePublished 2026-03-25, dateModified 2026-04-14): a high-performance data centre is being created in The Hive technology park near CERN; Adresse: Rte du Nant-d'Avril 152, 1217 Meyrin; total power 4.5 MW; available from 2028.
NorthC post of 30 September 2026: 'im 2028 ein Hightech-Rechenzentrum in Genf' and 'RZs in Münchenstein, Biel, Winterthur und Genf (2028)'.
The federal search returns exactly one official address for Route du Nant-d'Avril 152 1217 Meyrin (EGAID 102543513, GWR EGID 295522333).

The federal building register (export 25 October 2026) records on the same parcel 11875 a projected building (status 1001) EGID 295530120 at Route du Nant-d'Avril 146c designated 'EXPLOITATION DU DATACENTER' (6 storeys, 1,853 m2), 77.5 m from the address point; it does not name NorthC, so it is recorded as uncertainty context, not as the locator.

consistency_checks.gwr_identify_600m_box: 69 GWR records in a 600 m box around the point; the only record with a data-centre designation is the projected EGID 295530120 ('EXPLOITATION DU DATACENTER', Route du Nant-d'Avril 146c, parcel 11875). Another projected building, EGID 295526171 (146a/146b, 1,002 m2, no designation), lies 30.7 m from the point.
